description: 8 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings of runway, burn, raise-or-cut and burn-multiple questions. Should-not-trigger covers neighbours: valuation, scenario trees, unit economics, fundraising narrative, and an unrelated personal budget.

queries.q: how long is our runway at the current burn?
wie viele Monate Runway haben wir noch?
should we raise now or cut costs to extend runway?
our net burn is accelerating, what does that do to our runway?
is our burn multiple healthy for a series A company?
Runway reicht nicht bis zur nächsten Finanzierungsrunde, was tun?
model cut versus grow for our cash position
when do we run out of money at this burn rate?
value this company with a DCF
build base, upside and downside scenarios for the market
what is our CAC payback period?
write the story for our seed pitch deck
help me plan my household grocery list
